title: Lakefront Townhome, Rooftop View, Walk to Marina
description:
This 4 BD/3BA townhome sits directly on Old Hickory Lake, an easy walk to Turtle Bay Marina and Sam's Sports Grill. Every level has its own porch, and the private rooftop deck looks straight out over the water.

HIGHLIGHTS
- Rooftop Deck w/ Water Views, Steps from Turtle Bay Marina
- 4 Bedrooms w/ King Bed in Master
- Smart TV w/ YouTube TV
- Kitchen & Bathroom Essentials
- Free Garage Parking
- Free WiFi

The space
This 4 story townhome features 4 bedrooms, each with spacious closets, new linens and complimentary toiletries. The house is accessible via the front entrance or the double attached garage. The home also includes a combination washer and dryer unit. Two parking spots are available in the double garage, with additional free street parking available.

First Level - Garage, Entrance and 4th Bedroom with full over full bunk bed and twin sized trundle.

Second Level - Spacious open concept Kitchen & Dining area, Living room and 3rd Bedroom with queen bed, Full bathroom w/ walk-in shower. Outside living space off the 3rd bedroom as well as Living area.

Third Level - Primary bedroom w/ King bed, and ensuite bathroom with walk-in shower. Second Bedroom w/ Queen bed and ensuite bathroom with shower tub combo. Both bedrooms have their own outdoor Balcony.

Fourth Level - Outdoor Rooftop Deck with beautiful panoramic views!

Guest access
Guests will have access to the entire home. They'll receive a four-digit access code before arrival to enter the unit through our smart lock. Additionally, there will be an onsite lockbox accessible in case of a smart lock failure. We provide 24/7 customer support to ensure you never get locked out.

Other things to note
We are the following minutes away from these destinations by car:
- 1 min from Sam's Sports Grill - Blue Turtle Bay
- 15 minutes from the Nashville International Airport (BNA)
- 18 minutes from Grand Ole Opry & Opry Mills Mall
- 20 minutes from Broadway, and DT Nashville
- 22 minutes from Belmont University
- 24 minutes from Vanderbilt University
